layers.name: mouth-o
layers.source: derived 'o' sleep-mouth (sampled color/edge from original mouth pixels; smile layer untouched)

limitations: Right (waving) arm overlaps the torso and shares outline strokes with the body; separating it would require reconstructing hidden body/outline pixels, so arm motion is expressed via whole-character transform (bounce/tilt) instead.
Legs merge into the body silhouette with shared outlines; not separated.
Head and headphones are a single shape fused with the torso outline at the neck; head tilt is approximated by gentle whole-character rotation.

Facial expressions come from the user-approved 6-panel expression sheet (references/pixi-expressions.png) extracted by tools/extract_expressions.py; the default face remains the original cut pixels. No invented face artwork.
The derived 'o' sleep-mouth asset is retained but unused by default: the sleeping state now uses the approved sheet expression (closed lids + small mouth + zz).
